source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of hormones as chemical messengers (PDF 57-58).

blocks.text: Nervous system tez asabi coordination karta hai, jabke endocrine system lambe arse ke amal jaise nashonuma (growth), metabolism aur tolid (reproduction) qaboo karta hai. Yeh jism ke target hisson ko kimiyai hidayat, yaani hormones, bhej kar aisa karta hai; yahi chemical coordination hai.

blocks.title: Hormone
blocks.text: Hormone aik nizami kimiyai madda hai jo endocrine gland khoon ya tissue fluid mein chhorta hai. Khoon ise har cell tak le jata hai, magar yeh sirf apne khaas target cells par asar karta hai jo khaas tarah jawab dete hain; is liye hormones ko kimiyai paighambar (chemical messengers) ya signalling molecules kehte hain.

blocks.title: Exocrine aur endocrine glands
blocks.text: Glands woh tissues hain jo ifrazat banate aur chhorte hain. Exocrine glands apne ifrazat nalyon (ducts) mein dalte hain; endocrine glands be-nali hain aur apne ifrazat, yaani hormones, seedha khoon ya tissue fluid mein chhorte hain.

blocks.title: Pehla hormone
blocks.text: 1902 mein Bayliss aur Starling ne dekha ke jab tezabi gastric juice chhoti aant mein aata hai to aik madda, jise unhon ne secretin kaha, khoon mein chhoot'ta hai; yeh pancreas tak pohanch kar use pancreatic juice chhorne par majboor karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Hormone ko kimiyai paighambar kyun kehte hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh khoon mein chhora gaya kimiyai madda hai jo apne gland se door ke target cells tak paigham le jata hai, aur woh khaas tarah jawab dete hain.

items: Endocrine system: hormones ke zariye lambe arse ka qaboo (nashonuma, metabolism, tolid); hormones har cell tak jate magar sirf target cells par asar karte hain.
